scope: Shared child waits and lifecycle event foundation; full lifecycle migration remains active
benchmark_method: Nine counterbalanced before/after pairs per API and CPU count; same static ARM64 musl ELF; startup/teardown excluded by guest timestamps; fixture includes start/end barriers. Native reference is the local Lima ARM Linux instance, not bare-metal Darwin.

unit_tests.reused_kernel_reason: The final handoff and projection fixes change only trames-session, not the already tested trames-kernel sources.

found_and_fixed: Cross-cohort wait adoption manufactured a generic I/O retry for a completed child wait; actual Docker exposed the panic. Typed child wait custody now excludes this duplicate retry.

Owner PID query projections were collected only at the next cohort admission. They are now collected before returned owner syscalls; the regression requires immediate getpgid ESRCH after source reaping.
Native Linux oracle corrected output-pointer checking and event-consumption semantics, including wait4/waitid rusage copy order.
remaining_boundaries: Task and group exit cleanup, clear_tid and parent-death policy
Reparenting/namespace-init teardown and resource projection release
